source:
@@U01591@@
And the magic flow
Of his talk, the bliss
In the clasp of his hand,
And oh! his kiss!
My peace is gone,
My heart is sore,
Ill find it never
And never more.
My heart cries out,
My sad heart pines,
To hold him fast,
And keep him mine,
And kiss him, kiss him,
Night and day,
And on his kisses
Die away!

@@U01596@@
Promise me, 海因里希!

@@U01598@@
Whatever I can.

@@U01600@@
Well—religion.
How do you feel about it?
You're such a kind,
such a good-hearted man,
and yet it seems not to
matter much to you.
translation:
@@U01591@@
还有神奇的流动
他的谈话，幸福
在他的手中，
还有哦！他的吻！
我的平静消失了
我的心好痛，
我永远找不到它
再也不会了。
我的心在呐喊，
我悲伤的心松散，
想要牢牢地抱住他，
并让他成为我的，
然后吻他，吻他，
白天和黑夜，
还有他的吻
死吧！

@@U01596@@
答应我，海因里希！

@@U01598@@
尽我所能。

@@U01600@@
嗯——宗教。
你对此有何感想？
你是这样一个人，
这么一个心地善良的人，
但似乎并没有
对你来说很重要。
